subject: Take-home: systems-inference assignment + reviewer slate
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Take-home: systems-inference assignment + reviewer slate

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for your time yesterday. As discussed, attached is the take-home assignment for the Backend Platform Engineer role (systems inference prompt). Aim for 6–10 hours of work — we care more about tradeoffs and reasoning than completeness.

High-level:
- Deliverables: design doc (PDF or Google Doc) + a short runnable snippet (optional) packaged with the submission template.
- Deadline: end of day (PST) Tuesday, Nov 30 — please let me know if you need an extension.
- Submission: reply to this thread with your deliverables or upload to the Drive link below.

Attachments: TA-Systems-Inference.pdf (instructions), submission-template.zip (skeleton repo + README)
Drive link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-takehome

We’ve assembled a small reviewer slate: Marissa (foundations + infra), Rishi (runtime/latency), and me for product alignment. Expect a 45–60 minute sync for discussion if we need to follow up.

If anything in the prompt is unclear, feel free to ask here — quick clarifying Qs are fine. Good luck!

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Engineering Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@gmail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 12:18:22 -0500
Subject: Re: Take-home: systems-inference assignment + reviewer slate

Thanks Jonas — got it, and I pulled the Drive doc and attachments. Quick question: the prompt references a 100M-token/day workload profile — is that peak QPS, or an amortized daily throughput? I want to make sure I use the right latency/throughput assumptions in the design.

Also — Tuesday the 30th should work, but if anything unexpected comes up I may ask for a 48h extension.

Thanks,
Priya

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Team —

Priya confirmed receipt and asked one clarifying question (Jonas, see her note). I’m coordinating reviewer bandwidth so we can review submissions next week. Proposed plan:

- Review window: Wed, Dec 1 — Fri, Dec 3 (we’ll read independently but hold a 45-min triage on Mon Dec 6 if we require alignment).
- Reviewer roles: Marissa = infra & correctness, Rishi = runtime & perf, Jonas = product fit & tradeoffs. Marissa/Rishi: please indicate any blackout times.
- Feedback doc: I created a shared doc (linked) where we should leave comments and a short rubric (clarity, architecture, correctness, tradeoffs, testability).

Shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-takehome (comments section)
Rubric template: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rubric-template

Also attaching a short reviewer checklist as a stub to speed things up.

—Laura

Priya —

Great question. The 100M-token/day number is an amortized daily throughput; for latency targets assume 95th percentile under normal peak slices (~10% of daily traffic). I’ll update the prompt with an assumptions callout — thanks for flagging.

Confirmed: deadline Tue Nov 30 EOD PST; please let us know if you need a 48h extension and we’ll accommodate. When you submit, include a oneparagraph assumptions section and toggle the README in the submission-template.

Marissa will be the primary infra reviewer and will lead triage if we need it. Rishi will focus on runtime/latency. Laura will coordinate feedback collection.

Looking forward to your submission — good luck.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Eng Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
